object: Малая изба — дёрн по бересте, курная
pivot_rule: screen point of the footprint centre at z = 0 (scale.md §4.1)
placement: place the sprite so that proto_corner_px lands on iso.js toS(p.x, p.y) (footprint min corner), equivalently pivot on the screen point of the footprint centre ((x0 + A/2), (y0 + B/2))
sort: sort by the FRONT (lower, +x+y) corner of the footprint, scale.md §4.1: depth key = (x0+A) + (y0+B) in tiles, screen y of front_corner_px

xray.rule: scale.md 1.4 §4.4 / GDD v1.13 §10.3: if the sprite intersects the ellipse rx 56, ry 40 px centred at hero pivot − 22 px and the building sorts IN FRONT of the hero, draw the whole sprite at alpha 0.35 (0.2 s transition); hero gets a 1-px bronze_hi outline when ≥ 25% covered

notes: Курная: только волоковые окошки, дым — fx_smoke_wisp в anchors_px.smoke
frame_2: без видимой двери (задняя сторона); по GDD v1.13.2 двери только на +x/+y — для плана не использовать
frames: door on a hidden side (−x / −y): windows only
